description: Pins the SSL GET path plus the Option B instance_id rejections, which agree across languages. Three cases, not the five its PostgreSQL sibling carries: that file names the same {} payload twice and the same {"instance_id": 0} payload twice, so the extra rows read as coverage no new input creates.

cases.name: rejects a non-positive instance_id
cases.expect_error: instance_id must be a positive integer
